title: RagQueryRequested
description: A question somebody wants answered out of what was put in. Carries the whole question, for the same reason repurpose does. Keys are snake_case, not the camelCase the rest of leaf uses: this travels inside a Liquid envelope, whose own fields (event_id, occurred_at, event_type, owner_unit_ref) are snake_case and pinned byte-exact by signed golden vectors. The shape follows the wire.

job_id.description: The job to report the answer against, created by the pipeline if it does not exist yet.

session_id.description: The working session to search in. The question is answered out of that session's material, not out of everything.

query.description: The question, in natural language. A blank one is not worked.

top_k.description: How many chunks to retrieve before answering. Absent leaves it to whoever searches.

asset_type.description: Search only this kind of asset. Absent searches all of them.

language.description: BCP-47 tag of the language to answer in. Detected from the question when absent.

response_mode.description: What to return: an answer grounded in the sources, or only the rewritten text, with nothing around it, for an editor that drops it straight into a document.
